expectations.subject: James Cook III
expectations.statement: Retain the leading Buffalo rushing role if active; do not expect another 31 carries or a receiving floor.
expectations.support: 31 Week9 carries versus Davis2/Johnson1; one receiving target.
expectations.uncertainty: Game script, short week and goal-line/QB allocation can change volume.
expectations.challenge: A shared or reduced rushing role, or injury restriction, challenges the selection.
expectations.observe: Compare carries/targets and team volume, actual active status; snaps/routes only if verified.

expectations.subject: Denzel Boston
expectations.statement: Remain a meaningful receiving participant rather than relying on a repeat 60-yard gain, conditional on current QB and availability.
expectations.support: Seven Week9 targets versus Concepcion6/Fannin2; primary recap confirms long gain.
expectations.uncertainty: One-game sample, QB unresolved, reported routes not independently verified.
expectations.challenge: Reduced participation or a QB/role change before cutoff; after game low absolute involvement challenges the premise.
expectations.observe: Compare targets/catches with Browns attempts and other receivers; verified routes if available.

expectations.subject: Kenyon Sadiq
expectations.statement: Continue a receiving role alongside Mason Taylor if active; no fixed minimum or expanded role is assumed.
expectations.support: Four targets/four catches/49 yards; primary coach describes deliberately finding a mismatch.
expectations.uncertainty: One-game role, blocking duty, Wilson/Cooper availability and Taylor competition.
expectations.challenge: Current route/role evidence returning him mainly to blocking or inactive/limited status.
expectations.observe: Compare targets and other TEs/team attempts; measured routes/snaps if available.

expectations.subject: Keenan Allen and Tyler Warren
expectations.statement: Both continue receiving involvement if active; the two-player allocation needs sufficient absolute passing opportunity, not just shares.
expectations.uncertainty: Same-team competition, offense quality and game script; Downs remains a competing choice.
expectations.challenge: Reduced routes/targets or lower team passing opportunity undermines the two-slot allocation.
expectations.observe: Compare both target counts against team attempts, Downs and actual passing yards; assess role separately from TDs.

expectations.subject: Los Angeles Rams DST

expectations.uncertainty: Rams own offensive injuries and McDuffie uncertainty; rookieQBnotconfirmed, normalfullworkloadnotassumed.
expectations.challenge: Garrett setback/restriction, Arizona protection/starter resolution or further Rams coverage loss before cutoff.
